title: Great idea but too many bugs
body: I like the design, the features and the customised settings. I think the game idea is great, I had a lot of fun in the first week. However, some things don't work properly. If the Cub comes from travelling, you can't open what it has brought with it. And the choice between XP and Personality doesn't work either. So there is no interesting progress in the levels. A great pity, especially because comparable apps have a much worse design and functions. All in all, not worth the money.
